CustomField.description: The month the organization's fiscal year starts, 1 for January through 12 for December. Every fiscal year rollup window is computed from this at run time, so changing it and recalculating corrects every year based total in the org.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The month your fiscal year starts: 1 for January, 7 for July.
CustomField.label: Fiscal Year Start Month
